question: Choose the correct **one-word substitution** for: 'A person with great skill in music or arts'.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Virtuoso**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The word **"Virtuoso"** refers to a person who is highly skilled in music or arts. (संगीत या कला में अत्यधिक कुशल व्यक्ति)

 

 
• **Example:** She is a virtuoso pianist who captivates audiences with her performances.

 

 
• **"Virtuoso"** is often used to describe someone who has mastered a particular art form or skill to an extraordinary degree. (किसी कला या कौशल में असाधारण दक्षता प्राप्त व्यक्ति)

 

 
• **Example:** The gallery showcased paintings by a virtuoso artist whose work is known worldwide.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Virtuoso**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Performer** (प्रदर्शन करने वाला व्यक्ति): A person who entertains an audience by acting, singing, dancing, or playing music.

 

 
• **Example:** The performer received a standing ovation for his flawless dance routine.

 

 
• **Composer** (संगीतकार): A person who writes music, especially as a professional occupation.

 

 
• **Example:** Beethoven is one of the most famous composers in history.

 

 
• **Prodigy** (प्रतिभाशाली व्यक्ति): A young person with exceptional qualities or abilities, often in a specific field like music, mathematics, or arts.

 

 
• **Example:** The child prodigy began playing the violin at the age of three.
